body: A 30-day Bible study challenge sparked Fivio Foreign’s spiritual awakening while he was in jail last year. "A person walked up to me with a Bible, out of nowhere," he tells Kirk Franklin. "If you got God, you could finesse me. " Hit link in bio to watch Fivio and Kirk's convo about faith and Christianity.
